) center/cover no-repeat}
#families::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(247,244,238,.9) 0%,rgba(247,244,238,.78) 45%,rgba(247,244,238,.86) 100%)}
#families .lead{color:#3d382f}
</style><style id="pp-css">
.person.pp{position:relative;cursor:pointer;transition:background .3s,padding-left .3s;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
.person.pp:hover,.person.pp:focus-visible{background:rgba(138,100,36,.06);padding-left:12px}
.person.pp:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #8a6424;outline-offset:-2px}
.person.pp>div>p:not(.role){display:none}
.person.pp .role{margin-bottom:14px}
.pp-more{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font:600 13px Jost,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#8a6424}
.pp-pl{position:relative;width:24px;height:24px;border:1px solid rgba(138,100,36,.55);border-radius:50%;transition:transform .4s,background .3s}
.pp-pl::before,.pp-pl::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:10px;height:1px;background:#8a6424;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
.pp-pl::after{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(90deg)}
.person.pp:hover .pp-pl{background:#8a6424;transform:rotate(90deg)}
.person.pp:hover .pp-pl::before,.person.pp:hover .pp-pl::after{background:#fff}
.pp-card[hidden],.wy-back[hidden]{display:none!important}
.pp-card{width:min(680px,calc(100vw - 32px));display:grid;grid-template-columns:220px minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(20px,3vw,34px);align-items:start}
.pp-img{width:220px;height:220px;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top;border:1px solid rgba(138,100,36,.6);padding:4px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(10,8,4,.18)}
.pp-card h4{margin:4px 0 6px;font:500 clamp(28px,3.4vw,38px)/1.1 "Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif;color:#15130f}
.pp-role{margin:0 0 16px;font:500 12px Cinzel,serif;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#8a6424}
.pp-card .wy-p{margin:0}
.pp-card.show .pp-img,.pp-card.show h4,.pp-card.show .pp-role,.pp-card.show .wy-p{animation:wyin .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) backwards}
@media(max-width:620px){.pp-card{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);padding-top:34px}.pp-img{width:150px;height:150px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.pp-card.show *{animation:none!important}.pp-pl{transition:none}}
</style></head>
